As a (Senior) FP&A Analyst, you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy and driving business performance within a globally distributed organization. You will lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management activities, translating complex financial and operational data into actionable insights. Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help guide strategic decisions, identify risks and opportunities, and strengthen financial discipline across the business. You will also develop robust financial models, reporting tools, and performance indicators to support sustainable growth. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise with commercial thinking in a fast-paced, international, remote-first environment. Accountabilities: You will oversee financial planning and performance management processes while acting as a trusted business partner to leadership and operational teams. Your work will help ensure accurate reporting, informed decision-making, and alignment between local financial performance and broader organizational objectives. Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business. Analyze financial and operational performance, identifying variances, risks, opportunities, and actionable recommendations for senior leadership. Collaborate with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance. Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to facilitate decision-making and investment assessments. Ensure consistency between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
jobs.description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. What will your job look like: Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components. Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform. Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup). Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target. Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack. Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. WHY JOIN US The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. About the Team The Flight Test organization is a mission-focused, flat, and highly collaborative multinational team that serves as the critical bridge between engineering labs and real-world deployment. Working directly alongside software and hardware engineering, the team runs high-tempo flight campaigns globally to rapidly iterate, validate, and field STARK’s advanced autonomous platforms. Your Mission As a Flight Test Engineer, depending on your experience, you will be responsible for the planning, execution, and analysis of flight tests for experimental fixed-wing UAV platforms. You will work closely with the experimental R&D team to conduct flight research or validate system performance and contribute to the next generation of our autonomous flight technologies. What you will be doing at STARK Plan, coordinate, and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with all applicable safety and operational protocols.  Develop flight test plans, test cards, and flight test hazard assessments.

jobs.description: REQ ID: CSQ128R183 Location: Munich or Berlin - Germany Mission The Forward Deployed AI Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialised customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services (PS) engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications with a focus on GenAI. We work cross-functionally with AI/ML Product, Research, and Engineering to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives. We are looking for a world-class leader to lead and grow our EMEA AI FDE team. jobs.description: Über uns: HyPlus ist Dein Wegbegleiter im digitalen Wandel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert, deren digitale DNA. Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in Automotive, Handel, Banken & Versicherungen sowie dem öffentlichen Sektor. Bei uns ist KI kein Innovationstheater. Wir betreiben einen eigenen GPU-Server, hosten Modelle selbst, betreiben einen eigenen AI Gateway und bauen für Kunden – insb. aus der Versicherungswirtschaft - Prozesse, die täglich echte Fälle entscheiden. Unser Center of Excellence AI ist die Stelle, an der neue Technologien zuerst ankommen, bewertet und dann in Projekte und in eine Guidance für unsere Mitarbeitenden übersetzt werden. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der/die wirklich tief drin ist: eine Person, die neue Modelle, Frameworks und Werkzeuge früh entdeckt, sie selbst ausprobiert und danach begründen kann, was davon in einem regulierten Unternehmensumfeld trägt und was nicht. Ungefähr 70 % der Zeit arbeitest du direkt in Kundenprojekten, rund 30 % gehören dem Center of Excellence (CoE) und damit der Frage, wo wir in achtzehn Monaten stehen. jobs.title: Sales Specialist/in – Steuerberatung neu gedacht (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du hörst gerne zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und machst aus Interesse eine gute Entscheidung? Dann hilf uns, neue Mandant:innen für b’steuern zu gewinnen. Täglich erreichen uns Menschen, die ihre Steuerberatung verändern wollen. Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen und Unternehmen, die sich digitale Abläufe, klare Preise und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit wünschen. Deine Aufgabe: verstehen, was sie brauchen, unser Angebot verständlich machen und sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Entscheidung begleiten. Über uns b’steuern ist keine klassische Kanzlei. Wir beraten Selbstständige, Freelancer:innen, Interim Manager:innen und Unternehmen bis 100 Mio. Euro Umsatz. Dabei arbeiten wir voll digital, entwickeln eigene Tech- und KI-Lösungen und hinterfragen konsequent, was Steuerberatung unnötig kompliziert macht. Unser Ziel: So einfach wie möglich für alle Beteiligten – mit der Kraft von Tech und KI. Was uns besonders macht: Radikal digital: Wir setzen auf moderne Software, KI und eigene Tech-Lösungen, um manuelle Arbeit zu reduzieren. jobs.title: Finance Team Lead (d/f/m)
jobs.description: A bit about the finance function at Luminovo Over the last 4 years, Luminovo has grown on a 73% compounding growth rate. Throughout this time, Luminovo’s Finance team has consisted of never more than 1.5-2 FTE and a part-time leader (Benedikt). The leadership role is graduating and needs to become full-time. Apart from that, we’re good for years to come and find delight in keeping the team as small as possible! We love to overwhelm our financial service providers with demands for better API and are often leading our Claude’s lines-of-code company dashboards. Your role Build a finance function that scales through better systems, not a bigger team. We’re making our finance leadership a full-time role. You’ll lead and coach a team of two while staying close to the work: accounts, cash, reporting and the systems behind them. We want a finance operator who enjoys building with code and AI, not just introducing new tools. What you’ll own Own daily closing across our organisations on at least two continents. Improve the automation and controls behind it, whether the system is already running or still needs work when you join. Build automatic financial feedback loops across Luminovo. Give leaders the information they need where they work, and use code and AI to automate routine decisions so people can focus on complex judgement. Keep shareholders and lenders informed with timely, accurate reporting they can trust. Protect our cash position. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description: About the team: The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp. We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team's success. As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp's identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you'll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn't required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter. We're looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You'll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users. What you'll do: Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems. Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users. Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers. Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact prefer

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Reconciliation
jobs.description: About us: BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We re now part of Mastercard, and together we re building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice. We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration. Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we re assembling a world-class team to make it happen. Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today. By combining Mastercard s global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK s stablecoin infrastructure, we re building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation. We re a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift. We re incredibly honored to have been recognized by: CNBC World s Top Fintech Companies (2026) FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026) Newsweek s The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025) LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025) About this role in the team: We re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Reconciliation and Financial Reporting at BVNK. Your mission is to make sure every movement of money across the BVNK platform, in fiat and in stablecoins, is accounted for, matched and reported correctly.

jobs.description: FULL TIME, 5 DAYS ONSITE LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER THE LAST FRONTIER The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure. ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy. We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to. Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk. jobs.title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: Mission Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents. Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple. Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL. Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès. Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions. jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.  Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation. This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company. You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation. You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards. We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work. This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position. What You Will Own: 1. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. jobs.description: About the team Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk. What you'll do You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. Let's build together. Your impact This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. As an Merchant Risk Analyst, you are the first line of defense, proactively monitoring merchant activity to identify and mitigate patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider. You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. Your analysis and recommendations will directly shape cross-team decision-making across compliance, operations, and fraud strategy, positioning you as a trusted Subject Matter Expert. If you are driven to continuously challenge existing practices, propose improvements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, and want to master the craft of financial crime analysis, you will be key to strengthening our overall risk resilience and staying ahead of evolving threats in the payments landscape. What you'll ship Detect and investigate fraud risks through proactive monitoring, deep data analysis, and event-driven reviews of merchant activity. jobs.title: Strategy Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: Wemolo macht Parken einfach und digital: Kennzeichen-Scanner statt Schranken und Parktickets. Seit 2019 sind wir von München aus nach Österreich, in die Schweiz, nach Italien und nach Polen gewachsen und bewirtschaften heute mehr als 4.000 Parkflächen. Und unsere Reise ist noch lange nicht zu Ende. Für die nächsten Etappen suchen wir jemanden, der mitlenkt. Als Strategy Manager (all genders) bist du Teil unseres Strategy-Teams. Du nimmst Business Cases auseinander, baust den Plan und setzt ihn selbst um, bis das Ergebnis messbar ist. Wir sehen Wachstum wie einen Roadtrip: Du sitzt nicht auf der Rückbank, sondern legst die Route mit fest. What to expect Deine Projekte, von A bis Z: Du verantwortest strategische Projekte end-to-end. Du stellst den Business Case auf, planst und steuerst die Umsetzung, koordinierst die Stakeholder und misst den Erfolg des Projekts. Wachstum möglich machen: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teams, z.B. Business-Development, treibst du Initiativen voran, die die Basis für Wemolo’s Wachstumskurs bilden. Die große Linie mitgestalten: Du gestaltest unsere Unternehmensstrategie mit und bringst Struktur in die Frage, welche strategischen Prioritäten Wemolo setzt. Steuern und koordinieren: Du bringst die Unternehmenssteuerung und Governance von Wemolo auf das nächste Level, damit sie mit Wemolo’s Wachstumstempo Schritt halten. Klarheit für Entscheidungen: Du zerlegst komplexe Fragen und bereitest Entscheidungen so vor, dass sie schnell und fundiert getroffen werden. Brücke zwischen den Teams: Du arbeitest eng und auf Augenhöhe mit allen Fachbereichen zusammen und bringst Themen bereichsübergreifend auf die Straße. Beyond the Obvious: Du unterstützt das Management bei strategischen Sonderthemen abseits des Tagesgeschäfts, wie z. B. Partnerschaften oder Investitionsentscheidungen. Inspire us by Strategie-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits ca. 2-4 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Strategieberatung, einem StartUp/ScaleUp oder in einem Strategie- oder Business Development Team

jobs.description: Your Role As a Senior Controller, you take a key role in steering FINN’s financial performance. You deep-dive into P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance, explain variances against plan and identify the underlying drivers, with a particular focus on Gross Margin and unit economics. You translate data-driven insights into clear, actionable recommendations that help leadership steer the business. In addition, you contribute to our Group Management Reporting under HGB & IFRS and drive process and system improvements to scale with FINN’s growth. Your Mission Contribute to Management Reporting: Translate monthly and year-end closing accounts (HGB & IFRS) into an insightful Group Management Reporting for P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statement, targeting internal leadership, board, shareholders, and banks. Provide clear commentary on business performance and financial variance analysis against the plan, while continuously helping to develop the structure and content of the Management Reporting. Analyze Performance & Business Drivers: Deep-dive into financial and operational data to analyze P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow performance, and identify deviations against plan, the drivers of cost, revenue and cash flow, and their underlying root causes. Steer Gross Margin & Unit Economics: Own the analysis of Gross Margin P&L line items and unit economics, providing transparency on planned and actual profitability per subscription. Partner with leadership and business owners to evaluate financial trade-offs based on data-driven insights, for example in demand and supply steering, and to implement and track initiatives that improve profitability. Improve Processes & Systems: Drive company-wide process improvements, for example strengthening and aligning the monthly provisions process, and system improvements, such as setting up analyses in Lucanet or SAP-based cost center reporting, to improve the accuracy and transparency of our monthly financials. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity
jobs.description: About the team: The Identity team plays a critical role in delivering secure and seamless experiences for millions of SumUp users worldwide. We build and maintain authentication and account protection services, as well as central identity solutions that enable teams and products across SumUp. We are a cross-functional, engineering-driven team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We keep our processes lean, encourage open discussions, and believe in a strong team-first mentality where everyone contributes to the team s success. As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary focus will be backend development in Go, building reliable and scalable solutions that support SumUp s identity ecosystem. Depending on your interests and strengths, you ll also have opportunities to contribute to infrastructure, web, or mobile development. Previous experience in all these areas isn t required, curiosity and a willingness to get hands-on are what matter. We re looking for someone proactive and adaptable who enjoys taking ownership and driving initiatives end-to-end. You ll collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to shape requirements, design technical solutions, make implementation decisions, and drive rollouts. You ll have the opportunity to influence how we build and improve our services while making a meaningful impact on the security and experience of SumUp users.   What you’ll do: Collaborate with other engineers to design and build clean, reliable APIs, such as the next generation of our central Authentication and Permission APIs and facilitate a smooth gradual migration to these new systems. Evolve our authentication and authorization services that serve both internal and external users. Develop and ship solutions that enhance the security of our apps and SDKs, protect millions of users from fraud and account takeovers. Create secure, user-friendly self-service features that empower our users to manage their accounts and contact

Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today. At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits. jobs.description: The role Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you ll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You ll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won t be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real. This is a step-up opportunity. jobs.title: Senior SME Trading infrastructure (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional SME Trading Infrastructure. You will work closely with Götz Röhr , Pim Hannay and the Brokerage Product & Engineering Leadership team. In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial teams, driving topics critical to Upvest's success. What you can expect from this role: Impact and influence, laying the foundations on how one of Europe's leading infrastructure companies builds their trading infrastructure. Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere. Autonomy and ownership. You run your topics and are trusted to drive them to results. Being part of a group of experts, all having their own areas of expertise but working strongly together. Continuous learning across investments, API products, and modern product operations. What you’ll do: Develop upvest's future trading infrastructure

People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions. Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen hands-on, datengetriebenen Growth Engineer, der als erste Person die technische Basis für unser Brokerage-Geschäft baut. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Inside-Sales-Team sowie dem Leadership-Team zusammen und baust Brokerage zu einem eigenen, profitablen Geschäftsfeld aus. Brokerage ist bei Buena noch ein kleines Geschäftsfeld, mit dir soll daraus ein Multi-Millionen-Geschäft werden. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Signal-Engine bauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache. Outreach automatisieren: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment. jobs.title: Working Student – Research for Content (m/f/d)
jobs.description: How much house can people afford? Can we construct an index to show the trend? What is happening to household density? Are government subsidies on retirement savings well spent? With AI eroding the usefulness of light content, we are focussing more and more on the complex questions people need answers to. As a Working Student – Research for Content (m/f/d) you will actively help us gain deeper insights that support people making smarter decisions about their financial future, notably property purchasing and investments for retirement. You will work directly with our CFO, an ex-IMF/World Bank PhD economist, and a great team of people to support our mission with research that can be used for content and to attract interest. This research can cover the property market, the tax system for housing and other investments, and how retirement savings are supported. As a company, we make complex topics simple, and good research fits this by zeroing in on what matters and delivering razor-sharp analysis and conclusions. Does that sound enticing? Then apply now and join a team that enjoys exploring such questions. About us More generally, we are a great team that supports one another, learns from each other, and uses data to make informed decisions. We are highly motivated and deeply committed to our customers. We aim to leverage the best technology to deliver optimal results and uncover new insights. We are looking for working students who want to help challenge the status quo. Curious? Here’s what we’re looking for Your Responsibilities 💬 Conduct research with a focus on real, usable output. 🙌 Feel comfortable working with market data, economic or financial insights. 🧑‍💻 Help us create new and relevant insights, that get us the attention of users and AI bots. Your Profile 📚 You are an enrolled student in an economics, finance, or related field. 😊 You are inquisitive, curious to explore data to support insights, and ideally can point to some projects you did before. 🖥️

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller (gn)
jobs.description: Als spezialisierte Personalberatungsboutique bringen wir die besten Talente im Finanzbereich mit führenden Unternehmen in Berlin zusammen. Im Auftrag unseres Mandanten, einem Unternehmen aus der industriellen Automatisierung, suchen wir aktuell nach der passenden Persönlichkeit für die Position Senior Business Controller (gn). Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt! Ihre Aufgaben: Erstellung der monatlichen Managementberichte und internen Berichte für die Geschäftsleitung. Zusammenstellung und Einreichung der vierteljährlichen Berichtspakete an das Konzerncontrolling-Team in der Zentrale. Unterstützung der Konzernrevision durch Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Informationen und Abstimmung mit dem Konzernteam. Übernahme der vollen Verantwortung für den gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Jahresabschluss, einschließlich der Koordination seiner Erstellung und der Leitung des Prüfungsprozesses mit den externen Wirtschaftsprüfern. Direkte Berichterstattung an den Finanzleiter des Geschäftsbereichs und Sicherstellung der Übereinstimmung mit dessen Vorgaben und Erwartungen. Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Umsetzung der Unternehmensrichtlinien in allen Bereichen des Finanzcontrollings. Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Qualitätskontrolle innerhalb der Finanzbuchhaltung. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Steuerabteilung, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Meldepflichten, einschließlich Umsatzsteuer und Körperschaftsteuer, korrekt und fristgerecht erfüllt werden. Unterstützung von M&A- und Finanzierungsaktivitäten durch präzise finanzielle Einblicke und Berichterstattung. Route harnesses through rotating joints and moving axes: select flex- and torsion-rated cables and drive cable life tests together with mechanical engineering. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.title: Post-Silicon Validation Team Leader
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on. jobs.title: Business Development Lead
jobs.description: Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be. Sounds mega, right? Here's where you come in... jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. About the role Abound is changing the face of lending. Our data lake will change the pace and the way we operate. It will power most of the decisions we make, from credit and pricing to operations and finance, and it is the foundation of our AI future. None of that works without data people can trust. Our data is our most valuable asset, and this role is its custodian. As our Senior Data Engineer, you will own the warehouse that turns raw data from underwriting, lending, open banking and finance into the facts the whole company runs on. You will help shape that future. Through a semantic layer and natural-language-to-SQL tools, anyone at Abound will be able to ask a question in plain English and get a correct answer in seconds. You decide how the model is built, what it measures, and how AI uses it. You will not start from a blank page. The first version of the warehouse is live, with real users and real problems to solve. jobs.description: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss. Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead. Why join us Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed. We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build. Our values Care We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship. Bias for Action We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory. Ownership We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results. jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Contexte du stage Au sein de l'équipe Fondation (ingénieurs Fullstack et SRE), vous aurez un rôle central pour améliorer l'Expérience Développeur (DX) chez Doctrine : simplifier et sécuriser les processus quotidiens de développement, avec un impact direct sur l'efficacité de toutes les équipes techniques. Conception et spécifications : comprendre et formaliser les besoins avec l'équipe Fondation, puis rédiger le cahier des charges (spécifications techniques et fonctionnelles). Planification itérative : une fois le cahier des charges validé, définir un plan de mise en œuvre par lots, pour des livraisons fréquentes et une visibilité constante sur l'avancement. Les missions Mission principale : Conception et mise en place d'un outil de validation automatisé dans nos pipelines CircleCI pour vérifier la conformité de notre code d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) avec nos règles internes, au sein d'une infrastructure récente basée sur AWS et Terraform . Contrôle augmenté par LLM : Intégration de modèle
